answer: Price the edge, not the node. Each trust edge loses half its weight per year, and a panel that is not diverse voids the attestation. Every claim gets re-checked by a party that gains nothing from it passing. Twelve hours of honest work buys one edge, and a bought edge decays to nothing before a farm can amortise it. A mirror inspection, a bridge load test and a harbor manifest are cheap to do once and expensive to fake at scale.
